description: This is a Python script for converting a JSON data model into C source code files, including functions for parsing, generating, and writing C code structures based on the JSON input.

methods.name: getlastname
methods.description: Extracts the last part of a dot-separated name after removing a specific pattern.

methods.name: getname
methods.description: Generates a name based on object name, with specific string replacements depending on dot and placeholder counts.

methods.name: getarrayoptionparam
methods.description: Retrieves a list parameter from a dictionary if it exists.

methods.name: getprotocolsparam
methods.description: Determines protocol type based on list content in a dictionary.

methods.name: getargsparam
methods.description: Extracts argument name and value from a dictionary.

methods.name: get_mapping_param
methods.description: Retrieves mapping parameters based on type (uci, ubus, procfs, sysfs, cli).

methods.name: printGlobalstrCommon
methods.description: Appends a string to a common C source file.

methods.name: get_mapping_obj
methods.description: Retrieves mapping object details based on type.

methods.name: generate_validate_value
methods.description: Generates C code for validating a value based on its parameters and type.

methods.name: printheaderObjCommon
methods.description: Writes a comment header for an object in a C source file.

methods.name: cprintheaderOBJS
methods.description: Writes object array declaration in a C source file.

methods.name: hprintheaderOBJS
methods.description: Writes object array declaration in a header file.

methods.name: cprinttopfile
methods.description: Writes top comment and include directives in a C source file.

methods.name: hprinttopfile
methods.description: Writes top comment and include guards in a header file.

methods.name: hprintfootfile
methods.description: Writes closing include guard in a header file.

methods.name: cprintAddDelObj
methods.description: Generates C functions for adding and deleting objects.

methods.name: cprintBrowseObj
methods.description: Generates C code for browsing object instances.

methods.name: cprintGetSetValue
methods.description: Generates C code for get/set value functions with validation.

methods.name: cprintOperateCommands
methods.description: Generates C code for operation command functions.

methods.name: cprintEvent
methods.description: Generates C code for event functions.

methods.name: cprintheaderPARAMS
methods.description: Writes parameter array declaration in a C source file.

methods.name: hprintheaderPARAMS
methods.description: Writes parameter array declaration in a header file.

methods.name: printPARAMline
methods.description: Generates C code line for a parameter, including validation and access rights.

methods.name: printCOMMANDline
methods.description: Generates C code line for a command, including operation functions.

methods.name: printEVENTline
methods.description: Generates C code line for an event, including event functions.

methods.name: printtailArray
methods.description: Writes array terminator in parameter array.

methods.name: printOBJline
methods.description: Generates C code line for an object, including child objects and parameters.

methods.name: print_dmc_usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: object_parse_childs
methods.description: Recursively parses object children and parameters to generate code.

methods.name: generatecfromobj
methods.description: Generates C source and header files for a given object and its children.

methods.name: removetmpfiles
methods.description: Removes temporary files used during code generation.

methods.name: generatecfromspecificobj
methods.description: Finds and generates code for a specific object within data.
